entities.summary: Jamil Douglas is an American former professional football guard. He played college football at Arizona State. He has been a member of the Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots, Atlanta Falcons, Indianapolis Colts, Tennessee Titans, Buffalo Bills, Washington Football Team and New York Giants.
